units.title: Hello!
units.goal: Greet people, ask how they are, say thank you, sorry and goodbye.

units.title: What's your name?
units.goal: Introduce yourself, ask for names and nationality, and say who people are.

units.title: Numbers and age
units.goal: Count to 99, ask and give ages, and say how many people or things there are.

units.title: My family
units.goal: Talk about your family members, their jobs and your pets.

units.title: Time and dates
units.goal: Tell the time, say dates and days of the week, and say when you go somewhere.

units.title: Food and drink
units.goal: Say what you would like to eat and drink, what you like, and make a suggestion.

units.title: Shopping
units.goal: Ask prices, say what you want to buy, and count books, clothes and things.

units.title: Where is it?
units.goal: Say where people and things are, where you live and where you work.

units.title: Learning Chinese
units.goal: Talk about what you can do, ask how to read or write a character, and talk about studying.

units.title: Weather and free time
units.goal: Talk about the weather, phone calls, getting around and what has happened.

units.title: Family and introductions
units.goal: Introduce your family, ask someone's surname politely and welcome guests.

units.title: My daily routine
units.goal: Describe your daily routine, say how long things take and whether you are busy or tired.

units.title: Shopping for clothes
units.goal: Buy clothes, talk about colors and prices, bargain and ask for permission.

units.title: At a restaurant
units.goal: Order food and drinks, offer choices, and say what you like best.

units.title: Asking for directions
units.goal: Ask and give directions, and say how far places are from each other.

units.title: Travel experiences
units.goal: Talk about trips, transport and tickets, and say what you have or have never done.

units.title: Health and exercise
units.goal: Say how you feel, give reasons with 因为…所以, and give simple health advice.

units.title: Hobbies and parties
units.goal: Talk about hobbies and sports, say how well people do things, and celebrate a birthday.

units.title: School and work
units.goal: Ask and answer questions in class or at work, say what is right or wrong, and ask for help.

units.title: Weather and comparisons
units.goal: Compare people and things, describe the weather, and say what is about to happen.

units.title: My Daily Routine
units.goal: Describe your daily routine and say when and in what order you do things.

units.title: Describing People
units.goal: Describe what people look like and compare people and things.

units.title: School and Study
units.goal: Talk about classes, homework and exams, and say how well and how carefully something is done.

units.title: Home and Moving
units.goal: Talk about your home and neighbors, and say where you put things using 把.

units.title: A Bad Day
units.goal: Talk about small accidents and things that happened to you, using 被 and 过.

units.title: Asking for Directions
units.goal: Ask for and give directions, talk about getting around town, and describe movement with directional complements.

units.title: Eating Out
units.goal: Order food and drinks, pay in yuan, jiao and fen, and say whether you can or can't manage something.

units.title: Weather and Seasons
units.goal: Talk about the weather and the seasons and describe how things are changing.

units.title: Health and the Body
units.goal: Say what's wrong when you're ill, understand a doctor's advice, and give advice using 应该, 如果 and 只要.

units.title: Shopping for Clothes
units.goal: Shop for clothes, ask about sizes, colors and prices, and offer or ask for choices.

units.title: Hobbies and Free Time
units.goal: Talk about your hobbies, interests and weekend activities, and say what you are or aren't interested in.

units.title: At the Office
units.goal: Talk about work, meetings and decisions, give reasons and purposes, and stress when or how something happened.

units.title: Family and Feelings
units.goal: Talk about family members, relationships and feelings, and express contrast and surprise.

units.title: Travel and Culture
units.goal: Talk about travel, festivals and Chinese culture, and give your point of view with 对…来说.

units.title: City Life and the Future
units.goal: Describe changes in your city and its environment, talk about future plans, and use rhetorical questions.

units.title: A New Life in the City
units.goal: Describe how your life has changed after a move and say how you feel about it.

units.title: Plans and Results
units.goal: Talk about a plan, the reasons behind a result, and what it takes to succeed.

units.title: Helping Others
units.goal: Talk about volunteering and health checks, and thank people for their help.

units.title: A Reporter's Life
units.goal: Talk about news, social issues and someone's job, and explain the steps of a task.

units.title: Facing Pressure
units.goal: Talk about stress and setbacks, and say you'll keep going even when things are hard.

units.title: Choosing a Major
units.goal: Discuss choosing a major or career, weigh conditions and challenge someone's assumptions.

units.title: Jobs and Experience
units.goal: Talk about professions and experience, follow rules and plans, and express surprise.

units.title: A Night at the Show
units.goal: Talk about shows and the arts, make polite requests and warn about consequences.

units.title: A Graduation Trip
units.goal: Plan a trip with friends, compare transport and prices, and give reminders and warnings.

units.title: Life Online
units.goal: Talk about the internet, online scams and trust, and describe how strongly something happens.

units.title: Settling In
units.goal: Talk about adapting to a new place and your first impressions, and say what you can or can't manage to do.

units.title: Life as a PhD Student
units.goal: Talk about study and work routines and renting a place, and give your view on pros and cons.

units.title: A Little Bookshop
units.goal: Talk about books, reading and feelings, and describe things that happened to someone using the passive.

units.title: A Changing World
units.goal: Describe gradual changes in daily life and the environment, and say what you were forced to do.

units.title: Good Friends
units.goal: Congratulate a friend, give and take advice, and talk about work news and healthy habits.

units.title: Our New Home
units.goal: Describe a home and its surroundings, list reasons in order and make gentle requests.

units.title: A Day at the Zoo
units.goal: Write about a day out, describe people's strengths and weaknesses, and apologize politely.

units.title: A Business Trip
units.goal: Talk about work schedules, trips and office manners, and say whether there's still time to do something.

units.title: Looking for Work
units.goal: Talk about applying for a job, filling in forms and everyday errands.

units.title: Studying in China
units.goal: Talk about studying Chinese abroad, study habits and holidays, and use fractions and percentages.

units.title: Teamwork on a Project
units.goal: Talk about goals, methods and progress in a work project using formal connectors.

units.title: Sport and Life Lessons
units.goal: Talk about training, competitions and what success means, and express surprise and impressions.

units.title: Stress and Mental Health
units.goal: Describe moods, stress and relationships, and talk about what happens once something goes wrong.

units.title: Films and Heroes
units.goal: Talk about films, characters and heroes, and give opinions with 在…看来 and 所谓.

units.title: Starting a Small Business
units.goal: Talk about running a business, risks and lucky breaks, and exaggerate with 简直.

units.title: Marketing and Public Image
units.goal: Discuss advertising, public image and emergencies, and say "still", "anyway" and "no need".

units.title: Growing a Business
units.goal: Talk about companies, principles and fairness, and use 自从, 尽量 and 不然.

units.title: Choosing a Career
units.goal: Talk about jobs, industries and life choices, and use 毕竟, 万一 and 像…似的.

units.title: Weddings and Money
units.goal: Talk about weddings, family finances and personal qualities, and compare options with 不如 and 至于.

units.title: Old Streets, New Life
units.goal: Talk about city development, history and everyday city life, and use 始终, 分别 and 有把握.

units.title: Campus Life
units.goal: Talk about student life, clubs and lessons learned, and use 除非…否则, 至今 and 总之.

units.title: Life After Retirement
units.goal: Talk about retirement, health and family memories, and use 反而, 此外 and 据说.

units.title: Back to the Village
units.goal: Talk about rural change, trade and personal decisions, and use 假如, 要不 and 从此.

units.title: Inventions and Persistence
units.goal: Talk about inventions, setbacks and determination, and use 哪怕…也, 从而 and 趁.

units.title: Leaving Home to Strive
units.goal: Talk about moving to a strange city, hardships and youth, and use 仿佛, 假装 and 干脆.

units.title: Jobs and Big Decisions
units.goal: Talk about jobs, unemployment and future prospects, and use 说不定, 总算 and 动不动就.

units.title: An Unlucky Day
units.goal: Describe everyday mishaps and discuss opinions objectively, using 难怪, 丝毫 and 善于.

units.title: Green Miracle in the Desert
units.goal: Talk about farming, technology and childhood, and use 越是…越 and 不是…而是.

units.title: Smart Shopping
units.goal: Talk about shopping, brands, prices and food, and use 何必…呢 and 特意 vs 顺便.

units.title: A Business Trip
units.goal: Handle travel, meetings and banquets on a business trip, and use 未必, 何况 and 怪不得.

units.title: Job Hunting
units.goal: Talk about job applications, interviews and daily life, and use 宁可…也不, 纷纷 and …的缘故.

units.title: A Family Trip
units.goal: Talk about travel experiences, food and scenery, and draw conclusions with 可见, 凡是 and 因而.

units.title: School Memories
units.goal: Talk about school days, mistakes and everyday objects, and use 幸亏, 不要紧 and 轮流.

units.title: New Year at Grandma's
units.goal: Talk about the Spring Festival, family and daily errands, and use 多亏, 再三 and 陆续.

units.title: Customs and Caring for Parents
units.goal: Talk about family values, customs and daily life, and use 与其…不如, 照常 and 不见得.

units.title: A Trip to Beijing
units.goal: Talk about sightseeing, learning Chinese and daily needs, and use 不免, 连忙 and polite 劳驾.

units.title: Breaking News
units.goal: Understand and discuss a news report about an accident, and correct assumptions with formal negation.

units.title: Into Space
units.goal: Follow a report on a rocket launch and talk about challenges, sacrifice and success using formal concessive structures.

units.title: In the Courtroom
units.goal: Read a report on a consumer lawsuit and discuss justice, using classical adverbs like 皆 and 亦.

units.title: Reviewing a Film
units.goal: Read and write a film review, commenting on plot, pacing and acting with formal degree words like 过于 and 足以.

units.title: Company Year in Review
units.goal: Understand a company leader's annual speech and give formal reasons and purposes with 鉴于 and 以便.

units.title: Health and Diet
units.goal: Read a health article about high blood pressure and discuss attitudes using 颇, 例外 and the 看待/对待 distinction.

units.title: Leaving the Big City
units.goal: Read a feature about a young man who returns to his village, and express sacrifice and extent with 不惜 and 到…的地步.

units.title: Choosing a Path
units.goal: Read an essay on choosing a university major and give advice using 以免, 愈…愈… and 致力于.

units.title: Beware of Scams
units.goal: Understand a report on phone fraud and give formal warnings and explanations with 勿, 不顾 and 之所以…是因为.

units.title: A Stream Reborn
units.goal: Read a story about restoring a polluted stream and make suggestions and complaints with 不妨, 偏偏 and 要不然.

units.title: Rumors and the Media
units.goal: Follow a story about an online rumor and a company's response, and express involuntary reactions and inevitability with 不禁, 难免 and 大不了.

units.title: Spending or Saving?
units.goal: Read a commentary on young people's spending habits and argue a point using 予以, 况且 and 犹如.

units.title: In Front of the Waterfall
units.goal: Read a travel essay with reflections on life and use literary expressions like 一如既往, 众所周知 and rhetorical 何尝.

units.title: A Century-Old Restaurant
units.goal: Read about how a traditional restaurant modernizes, and give formal instructions and results with 务必, 以致 and 若干.

units.title: An Ancient City Uncovered
units.goal: Read a report on an archaeological discovery and use formal cause-and-effect and evaluation with 致使, 不愧 and 恨不得.

units.title: A Boss Says Sorry
units.goal: Read a workplace story about layoffs and responsibility, and describe habits and abilities with 向来, 无从 and 勇于.

units.title: The Melting Arctic
units.goal: Read a popular-science article on climate change and evaluate opinions with 无非, 未免 and 进而.

units.title: Teaching on the Plateau
units.goal: Read a volunteer teacher's memoir and use formal expressions for scope and rules such as 截至, 便于 and 一律.

units.title: Reviving Traditional Arts
units.goal: Read a commentary on how traditional arts can attract young people, and argue with concessive and conditional structures like 固然…但, 倘若 and 时而…时而.

units.title: A Fisherman's Son
units.goal: Read a biographical sketch and highlight exceptions, degrees and long traditions with 唯独, 以至 and 历来.

units.title: Bringing Science to All
units.goal: Read a profile of a scientist who popularizes astronomy and reason about consequences with 势必, 反之 and 索性.

units.title: A Mining Town Reinvents Itself
units.goal: Read a report on how a declining mining town turned to tourism and summarize arguments with 不由得, 暂且 and 总而言之.

units.title: Grandma's Lantern Festival
units.goal: Read a family memoir about a grandmother and the Lantern Festival, and express eager wishes and surprises with 巴不得, 不料 and 姑且.

units.title: Welcome to My Province
units.goal: Describe the geography and customs of a region and use four-character idioms as adverbials and evaluations.

units.title: Idioms and Festivals
units.goal: Read a foreign student's reflections on Chinese culture and use modest formulas, fable-based idioms and literary 宁肯 and 假使.

units.title: Spoken vs Written Chinese
units.goal: Switch between casual spoken Chinese and formal written Chinese, recognising literary words such as 未, 即, 且 and 之所以.

units.title: Reading the News
units.goal: Follow and retell neutral news reports, recognising how journalists cite sources, link facts and use formal particles like 将, 已 and 于.

units.title: Life Online
units.goal: Talk about the internet, apps and technology the way people do online, using 毫不, 凡是……都…… and 话说回来.

units.title: Literary Echoes
units.goal: Read and write literary prose, recognising classical words like 乃, 故, 其 and 及其 and lyrical patterns such as 每当…… and ……不已.

units.title: Humour and Wordplay
units.goal: Understand and enjoy Chinese humour—two-part sayings (歇后语), homophone puns (谐音) and ironic praise—and use them in conversation.

units.title: Feelings and Relationships
units.goal: Talk about feelings, friendship and relationships with nuance, and make requests and refusals politely and indirectly.

units.title: At the Office
units.goal: Handle workplace communication—emails, meetings and negotiations—with the right formal phrases, tact and professional vocabulary.

units.title: Debate and Persuasion
units.goal: Argue a case in Chinese: concede a point, push back, draw consequences and sum up, using 诚然, 以至于 and 归根结底.

units.title: Popular Science
units.goal: Read and explain popular-science topics—health, nature and probability—using analogies, instructions with 即可 and careful hedging.

units.title: Local Flavours and Customs
units.goal: Describe regional food, customs, places and history vividly, using naming expressions, AABB reduplication and narrative markers like 至此 and 从此.

units.title: Poetry in Everyday Speech
units.goal: Recognise and use classical poetry lines and allusions in modern conversation, balance ideas with parallel phrasing and sum up with 总的来说.

units.title: Speeches and Notices
units.goal: Give a formal speech and write official notices, using set openings, notice formulas like 届时 and 特此通知, and humble and honorific language.
